CRITICAL insight for Lemma 5.1: Our BracketFormula has ALL witnesses interior to (z0, z1) with NO endpoint conditions. The paper's bracket [A_0, B_1, ..., A_n](z_0, z_1) has A_0 at z_0 itself. This means the paper's three-case decomposition (Cases 1-3 on p.10) does NOT directly apply to our formalization. The peel-off-first-witness approach (finding first alpha_0 occurrence via HasAttainedINF) fails because knowing not-alpha_0 on (z0, r0) says nothing about beta_0 (segmentTypes 0) on (z0, r0).
